scripts.desktop:windows: node desktop/build_server.js && node tools/build_client.mjs build --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json --features client-only
scripts.desktop:linux: node desktop/build_server.js && node tools/build_client.mjs build --config src-tauri/tauri.linux.conf.json --features client-only
scripts.android:prepare: npm run android:config && tauri android init --ci && node tools/android_permissions.mjs
scripts.android:build: npm run android:config && node tools/android_permissions.mjs && node tools/build_client.mjs android build --apk --target aarch64 --config src-tauri/tauri.android.conf.json --features client-only
